title: forecast.yaml
description: #31: the day-by-day weather forecast fetched in the week before departure (scripts/forecast.py). Official forecasts first (a national weather service such as the JMA); a model forecast only where no official one is had, and marked so. At most 7 days ahead: a day beyond that has no entry and reads 尚無預報.

fetched_at.description: When it was fetched, ISO 8601 with its UTC offset. The reader marks a forecast older than 48 hours 預報已過時.

place.description: The forecast area or point, e.g. 石狩・空知・後志地方 / 札幌.

weather.description: In Chinese: 晴 / 多雲時有雪 …

snow.description: Snow or ice is forecast: the day carries a 防滑 reminder.

rain.description: Rain is forecast: an outdoor day carries a 雨具 reminder.
